properties.AboutText: With the **Vendor Card** you manage information about a vendor. Including the agreed terms of business for your trade with this vendor, such as payment terms, prices and discounts.

controls.name: No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the involved entry or record, according to the specified number series.

controls.name: Balance (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of your completed purchases from the vendor in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts including VAT on all completed purchase invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: BalanceAsCustomer
controls.caption: Balance (LCY) As Customer
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount that this company owes you. This is relevant when your vendor is also your customer. Vendor and customer are linked together through their contact record. Using vendor's contact record you can create linked customer or link contact with existing customer to enable calculation of...

controls.name: Balance Due (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of your unpaid purchases from the vendor in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts including VAT on all open purchase invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: IC Partner Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the vendor's IC partner code, if the vendor is one of your intercompany partners.

controls.name: Address
controls.tooltip: Specifies the vendor's address.

controls.name: ShowMap
controls.tooltip: Specifies you can view the vendor's address on your preferred map website.

controls.name: Copy Buy-from Add. to Qte From
controls.source_expr: Rec."Copy Buy-from Add. to Qte From"

controls.name: Allow Multiple Posting Groups
controls.tooltip: Specifies if multiple posting groups can be used for posting business transactions for this customer.

controls.name: Customized Calendar
controls.caption: Customized Calendar
controls.tooltip: Specifies if you have set up a customized calendar for the vendor.

controls.name: No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unique number that identifies the vendor. You can assign numbers automatically based on a number series or assign them manually.

controls.name: Name
controls.tooltip: Specifies the vendor's name that appears on all related documents. For companies, specify the company's name here, and then add the relevant people as contacts that you link to this vendor.

controls.name: Location Code2
controls.tooltip: Specifies the warehouse location where items from the vendor must be received by default.

controls.name: Balance (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of your completed purchases from the vendor in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts including VAT on all completed purchase invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: Balance Due (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total value of your unpaid purchases from the vendor in the current fiscal year. It is calculated from amounts including VAT on all open purchase invoices and credit memos.

controls.name: Payments (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of payments paid to the vendor.

properties.AboutText: With the **Item Card** you manage the information that appears in sales and purchase documents when you buy or sell an item, such as line description and price. You can also find settings for how an item is priced, replenished, stocked, and for how costing and posting is done.

controls.tooltip: Specifies that the related record is blocked from being posted in transactions, for example an item that is placed in quarantine.

controls.tooltip: Specifies the Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) for the item. For example, the GTIN is used with bar codes to track items, and when sending and receiving documents electronically. The GTIN number typically contains a Universal Product Code (UPC), or European Article Number (EAN).

controls.name: AmountToApply
controls.caption: Amount to Apply
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of the amounts on all the selected customer ledger entries that will be applied by the entry shown in the Available Amount field. The amount is in the currency represented by the code in the Currency Code field.

controls.name: PmtDiscountAmount
controls.caption: Pmt. Disc. Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of the payment discount amounts granted on all the selected customer ledger entries that will be applied by the entry shown in the Available Amount field. The amount is in the currency represented by the code in the Currency Code field.

controls.name: ApplnRounding
controls.caption: Rounding
controls.tooltip: Specifies the rounding difference when you apply entries in different currencies to one another. The amount is in the currency represented by the code in the Currency Code field.

controls.name: AppliedAmount
controls.caption: Applied Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the sum of the amounts in the Amount to Apply field, Pmt. Disc. Amount field, and the Rounding. The amount is in the currency represented by the code in the Currency Code field.

controls.name: ApplyingAmount
controls.caption: Available Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of the journal entry, sales credit memo, or current customer ledger entry that you have selected as the applying entry.

controls.name: ControlBalance
controls.caption: Balance
controls.tooltip: Specifies any extra amount that will remain after the application.

actions.tooltip: Insert new lines for the components on the bill of materials, for example to sell the parent item as a kit. actions.name: Get Bin Content

actions.name: Test Report
actions.caption: Test Report
actions.tooltip: View a test report so that you can find and correct any errors before you perform the actual posting of the journal or document.

actions.name: Post
actions.caption: P&ost
actions.tooltip: Finalize the document or journal by posting the amounts and quantities to the related accounts in your company books.

actions.name: PreviewPosting
actions.caption: Preview Posting
actions.tooltip: Review the different types of entries that will be created when you post the document or journal.

actions.name: Post and &Print
actions.caption: Post and &Print

actions.name: EditInExcel

Default values could be departments or teams, geographic regions or area codes, customers or vendors, salespeople or purchasers, and so on. Use them to filter, total, and do other types of analyses on reports.

controls.name: Gen. Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the vendor's or customer's trade type to link transactions made for this business partner with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.

controls.name: Gen. Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.

controls.name: VAT Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved customer or vendor to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

controls.name: VAT Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved item or resource to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

controls.name: Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total amount (including VAT) that the journal line consists of.

controls.name: Debit Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total of the ledger entries that represent debits.

controls.name: Credit Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total of the ledger entries that represent credits.

controls.name: VAT Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of VAT that is included in the total amount.

controls.name: VAT Difference
controls.tooltip: Specifies the difference between the calculated VAT amount and a VAT amount that you have entered manually.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of Bal. VAT included in the total amount.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Difference
controls.tooltip: Specifies the difference between the calculate VAT amount and the VAT amount that you have entered manually.

controls.name: Bal. Account Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of account that a balancing entry is posted to, such as BANK for a cash account.

controls.name: Bal. Account No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the general ledger, customer, vendor, or bank account that the balancing entry is posted to, such as a cash account for cash purchases.

controls.name: Bal. Gen. Posting Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the general posting type associated with the balancing account that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bal. Gen. Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the general business posting group code associated with the balancing account that will be used when you post the entry.

controls.name: Bal. Gen. Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the general product posting group code associated with the balancing account that will be used when you post the entry.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the VAT product posting group that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the VAT business posting group that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bill-to/Pay-to No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the bill-to customer or pay-to vendor that the entry is linked to.

controls.name: Ship-to/Order Address Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the address code of the ship-to customer or order-from vendor that the entry is linked to.

controls.name: Payment Terms Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies a formula that calculates the payment due date, payment discount date, and payment discount amount.

controls.name: Applies-to Doc. Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the posted document that this document or journal line will be applied to when you post, for example to register payment.

controls.name: Applies-to Doc. No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the posted document that this document or journal line will be applied to when you post, for example to register payment.

controls.name: Applies-to ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the ID of entries that will be applied to when you choose the Apply Entries action.

controls.name: On Hold
controls.tooltip: Specifies that the related entry represents an unpaid invoice for which either a payment suggestion, a reminder, or a finance charge memo exists.

controls.name: Bank Payment Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code for the payment type to be used for the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Reason Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the reason code, a supplementary source code that enables you to trace the entry.

controls.name: Comment
controls.tooltip: Specifies a comment about the activity on the journal line. Note that the comment is not carried forward to posted entries.

controls.name: Job Queue Status
controls.tooltip: Specifies the status of a job queue entry or task that handles the posting of general journals.

controls.name: ICAccountType
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of the account that you want to use for the transaction with your IC partner.

controls.name: ICAccountNo
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the general ledger or bank account that the IC transaction is posted to.

controls.name: Shortcut Dimension 1 Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code for Shortcut Dimension 1, which is one of two global dimension codes that you set up in the General Ledger Setup window.

controls.name: Shortcut Dimension 2 Code

actions.tooltip: View or edit dimensions, such as area, project, or department, that you can assign to sales and purchase documents to distribute costs and analyze transaction history.

actions.name: Card

actions.tooltip: View or change detailed information about the record on the document or journal line.

actions.name: Ledger E&ntries
actions.caption: Ledger E&ntries
actions.tooltip: View the history of transactions that have been posted for the selected record.

actions.name: Renumber Document Numbers
actions.caption: Renumber Document Numbers
actions.tooltip: Resort the numbers in the Document No. column to avoid posting errors because the document numbers are not in sequence. Entry applications and line groupings are preserved.

actions.name: Apply Entries
actions.caption: Apply Entries
actions.tooltip: Apply the payment amount on a journal line to a sales or purchase document that was already posted for a customer or vendor. This updates the amount on the posted document, and the document can either be partially paid, or closed as paid or refunded.

actions.name: Insert Conv. LCY Rndg. Lines
actions.caption: Insert Conv. LCY Rndg. Lines
actions.tooltip: Insert a rounding correction line in the journal. This rounding correction line will balance in LCY when amounts in the foreign currency also balance. You can then post the journal.

actions.name: Reconcile
actions.caption: Reconcile
actions.tooltip: View the balances on bank accounts that are marked for reconciliation, usually liquid accounts.

actions.name: Test Report
actions.caption: Test Report
actions.tooltip: View a test report so that you can find and correct any errors before you perform the actual posting of the journal or document.

actions.name: P&ost
actions.caption: P&ost
actions.tooltip: Finalize the document or journal by posting the amounts and quantities to the related accounts in your company books.

actions.name: Preview
actions.caption: Preview Posting
actions.tooltip: Review the different types of entries that will be created when you post the document or journal.

actions.name: Post and &Print
actions.caption: Post and &Print
actions.tooltip: Finalize and prepare to print the document or journal. The values and quantities are posted to the related accounts. A report request window where you can specify what to include on the print-out.

actions.name: Remove From Job Queue
actions.caption: Remove From Job Queue
actions.tooltip: Remove the scheduled processing of this record from the job queue.

actions.name: SendApprovalRequestJournalBatch

actions.tooltip: Send all journal lines for approval, also those that you may not see because of filters.

actions.name: SendApprovalRequestJournalLine
actions.caption: Selected Journal Lines
actions.tooltip: Send selected journal lines for approval.

actions.name: CancelApprovalRequestJournalBatch

actions.tooltip: Cancel sending all journal lines for approval, also those that you may not see because of filters.

actions.name: CancelApprovalRequestJournalLine
actions.caption: Selected Journal Lines
actions.tooltip: Cancel sending selected journal lines for approval.

actions.name: Approve
actions.caption: Approve
actions.tooltip: Approve the requested changes.

actions.name: Reject
actions.caption: Reject
actions.tooltip: Reject the approval request.

actions.name: Delegate
actions.caption: Delegate
actions.tooltip: Delegate the approval to a substitute approver.

actions.name: Comments
actions.caption: Comments
actions.tooltip: View or add comments for the record.

actions.name: ShowLinesWithErrors
actions.caption: Show Lines with Issues
actions.tooltip: View a list of journal lines that have issues before you post the journal.

actions.name: ShowAllLines
actions.caption: Show All Lines
actions.tooltip: View all journal lines, including lines with and without issues.

actions.name: EditInExcel

controls.name: Document No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies a document number for the journal line.

controls.name: External Document No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies a document number that refers to the customer's or vendor's numbering system.

controls.name: Account Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of account that the entry on the journal line will be posted to.

controls.name: Campaign No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the campaign that the journal line is linked to.

controls.name: Currency Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the currency for the amounts on the journal line.

controls.name: Gen. Posting Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of transaction.

controls.name: Gen. Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the vendor's or customer's trade type to link transactions made for this business partner with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.

controls.name: Gen. Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the item's product type to link transactions made for this item with the appropriate general ledger account according to the general posting setup.

controls.name: VAT Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved customer or vendor to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

controls.name: VAT Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the VAT specification of the involved item or resource to link transactions made for this record with the appropriate general ledger account according to the VAT posting setup.

controls.name: VAT %
controls.tooltip: Specifies the relevant VAT rate for the particular combination of VAT business posting group and VAT product posting group. Do not enter the percent sign, only the number. For example, if the VAT rate is 25 %, enter 25 in this field.

controls.name: Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total amount (including VAT) that the journal line consists of.

controls.name: Amount (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total amount in local currency (including VAT) that the journal line consists of.

controls.name: Debit Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total of the ledger entries that represent debits.

controls.name: Credit Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total of the ledger entries that represent credits.

controls.name: VAT Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of VAT that is included in the total amount.

controls.name: VAT Difference
controls.tooltip: Specifies the difference between the calculated VAT amount and a VAT amount that you have entered manually.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the amount of Bal. VAT included in the total amount.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Difference
controls.tooltip: Specifies the difference between the calculate VAT amount and the VAT amount that you have entered manually.

controls.name: Bal. Account Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of account that a balancing entry is posted to, such as BANK for a cash account.

controls.name: Bal. Account No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the general ledger, customer, vendor, or bank account that the balancing entry is posted to, such as a cash account for cash purchases.

controls.name: Bal. Gen. Posting Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the general posting type associated with the balancing account that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bal. Gen. Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the general business posting group code associated with the balancing account that will be used when you post the entry.

controls.name: Bal. Gen. Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the general product posting group code associated with the balancing account that will be used when you post the entry.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Bus. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the VAT business posting group that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bal. VAT Prod. Posting Group
controls.tooltip: Specifies the code of the VAT product posting group that will be used when you post the entry on the journal line.

controls.name: Bill-to/Pay-to No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the bill-to customer or pay-to vendor that the entry is linked to.

controls.name: Ship-to/Order Address Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the address code of the ship-to customer or order-from vendor that the entry is linked to.

controls.name: Payment Terms Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies a formula that calculates the payment due date, payment discount date, and payment discount amount.

controls.name: Applies-to Doc. Type

controls.name: Applies-to Doc. No.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the number of the posted document that this document or journal line will be applied to when you post, for example to register payment.

controls.name: Applies-to ID
controls.tooltip: Specifies the ID of entries that will be applied to when you choose the Apply Entries action.

controls.tooltip: Specifies if the journal line has been invoiced, and you execute the payment suggestions batch job, or you create a finance charge memo or reminder.

controls.name: Bank Payment Type

controls.name: Job Line Type
controls.tooltip: Specifies the type of planning line to create when a project ledger entry is posted. If the field is empty, no planning lines are created.

controls.name: Job Unit Of Measure Code
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit of measure code that is used to determine the unit price. This code specifies how the quantity is measured, for example, by the box or by the piece. The application retrieves this code from the corresponding item or resource card.

controls.name: Job Quantity
controls.tooltip: Specifies the quantity for the project ledger entry that is derived from posting the journal line. If the Project Quantity is 0, the total amount on the project ledger entry will also be 0.

controls.name: Job Unit Cost
controls.tooltip: Specifies the project cost of one unit of the item or resource on the journal line. The value is calculated as follows: Project Total Cost (LCY) / Project Quantity.

controls.name: Job Unit Cost (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the project cost of one unit of the item or resource on the journal line, in the local currency. The value is calculated as follows: Project Total Cost (LCY) / Project Quantity.

controls.name: Job Total Cost
controls.tooltip: Specifies if you have assigned a project number and a project task number to the journal line. It shows the amount excluding VAT divided by the project quantity for the journal line. The amount is shown in the currency specified for the project. controls.name: Job Unit Price
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit price for the selected account type and account number on the journal line.

controls.name: Job Unit Price (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the unit price, in the local currency, for the selected account type and account number on the journal line.

controls.name: Job Line Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the line amount of the project ledger entry.

controls.name: Job Line Amount (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the line amount of the project ledger entry.

controls.name: Job Line Discount Amount
controls.tooltip: Specifies the line discount amount of the project ledger entry.

controls.name: Job Line Discount %
controls.tooltip: Specifies the line discount percentage of the project ledger entry that is related to the purchase line.

controls.name: Job Total Price
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total price for the journal line. The value is calculated as follows: Quantity x Unit Price (LCY).

controls.name: Job Total Price (LCY)
controls.tooltip: Specifies the total price for the journal line, in the local currency. The value is calculated as follows: Quantity x Unit Price (LCY).

controls.name: Job Remaining Qty.
controls.tooltip: Specifies the quantity that remains to complete a project.

controls.name: Job Queue Status
controls.tooltip: Specifies the status of a job queue entry or task that handles the posting of general journals.

controls.name: Correction
